name: Common effective solid printed PLA
interpretation: Effective common comparison assumptions, not measured allowables or a validated fracture law. No directional strength credit; layer adhesion and defects are homogenized. Short-duration static loading only.
reference: Bambu PLA Basic TDS V3.0 gives typical XY/Z E 2580/2060 MPa and tensile strength 35/31 MPa for 100 percent infill, annealed/dried coupons. The chosen 25 MPa tension threshold is an analyst assumption, not a supplier rating.
